-- Key-Dup-Item trigger on B1.Call_Code: For debugging settings
-- PK1.debug2 is set by entering '*DEBUG' plus some characters into the
-- Call_Code and pressing F8 (Execute Query). The call_code value is
-- stored in Pk1.debug2, and used below.
-- Example *DEBUG* results in Pk1.debug2= '*DEBUG*'. Then pressing
-- the Duplicate Item key (F3)in the call_code field will cause this
-- trigger to set Pk1.Debug to Y or N.
--
If Pk1.debug2 = '*DEBUG*' then
 If Pk1.debug = 'Y' then
 Pk1.debug := 'N';
 else
 Pk1.debug := 'Y';
 end if;
 If Pk1.debug = 'Y' then
 Message(' Mouse-click on Owner field controls debug messages.'
 ,no_acknowledge);
 Else
 Message(' Mouse-click on Owner field is disabled.',no_acknowledge);
 End if;
Elsif Pk1.debug2 = '*DEBUG4*' then
 -- test NLS_Numeric_Characters client-side setting --
 -- They are set in the table setup process; will not be set
 -- when form first starts.
 declare nls_num_chars varchar2(2);
 tmp varchar2(10);
 begin
 select value into NLS_Num_Chars
 from nls_session_parameters
 where parameter='NLS_NUMERIC_CHARACTERS';
 select to_char(1000.1,'9g999d9') into tmp from dual;
 message('NLS_Numeric_Characters = '||NLS_Num_Chars
 ||' 1000.1 from Dual = '||tmp
 ||' 1000.1 local = '||to_char(1000.1,'9g999d9')
 ||' Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars='||Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars
 ||' Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars_Loc='||Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars_Loc
 ,no_acknowledge);
 end;
Else
 message(' Pk1.debug2 = "'||Pk1.debug2||'", no action taken.'
 ,no_acknowledge);
End if;

-- Key-ExeQry on B1.Call_Code --- Calls new form --*
-- This trigger is also run by the when-mouse-doubleclick trigger, and
-- also from WVI trigger (via a timer) if call_code is changed to a 
-- value other than this form.
-- Call_Code can be:
-- * EXIT exits the runform session.
-- * LOGON changes connections.
-- * RUN starts a new session, leaving the current session active.
-- * HELP or ABOUT: gives runform version.
-- In C/S Forms also gives command line help
-- * *DEBUGn* (n=1...5) for various debugging options.
-- * A different form to run.
Declare
 Call_Code Varchar2(60) := LTrim(:B1.Call_Code);
 QA Varchar2(20) := :System.Current_Form;

 Procedure Build_Paramlist (Run_or_New in varchar2 default 'N') is
 ----------------------------
 PId ParamList := Get_Parameter_List('QAPARMS');
 X Number;
 Y Number;
 MDI_txt Varchar2(30) := ' ';
 Begin
 If :Parameter.MDI_Window_Parms = '-' then
 MDI_txt := '-';
 Elsif Get_Application_Property(Operating_System) <> 'MACINTOSH'
 and Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_State)
 <>'MAXIMIZE' then
 X := Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,X_Pos);
 Y := Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Y_Pos);

 If Run_or_New='R' then -- Cascade position of second copy of form
 X:=X+.2; Y:=Y+.2;
 End if;
 MDI_txt := To_char(X)||','||To_char(Y)
 ||','||Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_Size)||',';
 End if;
 If Id_Null(PId) then
 PId := Create_Parameter_List('QAPARMS');
 Add_Parameter(PId,'MDI_WINDOW_PARMS',Text_Parameter,MDI_txt);
 -- Declare forces compile err if disclaimer deleted--
 Declare X varchar2(10):= :Parameter.Disclaimer; begin null; end;
 Add_Parameter(PId,'DISCLAIMER', Text_Parameter,'OFF');
 Add_Parameter(PId,'CASE_RESTRICTION', Text_Parameter,
 :Parameter.CASE_RESTRICTION);
 Add_Parameter(PId,'DATE_FORMAT', Text_Parameter,
 :Parameter.DATE_FORMAT);
 Else
 Set_Parameter_Attr(PId,'MDI_WINDOW_PARMS',Text_Parameter,MDI_txt);
 Set_Parameter_Attr(PId,'CASE_RESTRICTION', Text_Parameter,
 :Parameter.CASE_RESTRICTION);
 Set_Parameter_Attr(PId,'DATE_FORMAT', Text_Parameter,
 :Parameter.DATE_FORMAT);
 End if;
 End Build_Paramlist;

 Procedure Set_Globals is begin
 ------------------------------
 :Global.Case_Restriction := :Parameter.Case_Restriction;
 :Global.Date_Format := :Parameter.Date_Format;
 End Set_Globals;

 Procedure Call_New_Form is begin
 --------------------------------
 If Call_Code <> nvl(Pk1.CC_No_Such_Form,' ') then
 Pk1.CC_No_Such_Form := null;
 End if;
 U10_Clear_Form;
 If Pk1.Form_Title_Save is not Null
 and Get_Application_Property(Operating_System) <> 'MACINTOSH' then
 Set_Window_Property(FORMS_MDI_WINDOW,TITLE,
 Pk1.Form_Title_Save);
 End If;
 Build_Paramlist;
 Set_Globals;
 If Call_Code = QA then
 New_Form(QA,Full_Rollback,No_Query_Only,'QAPARMS');
 Else
 New_Form(Call_Code);
 End if;
 --If new_form fails...
 Pk1.CC_No_Such_Form := Call_Code;
 Do_Key('CLEAR_FORM');
 :B1.Call_Code := Call_Code;
 Pk1.Error_Item:='B1.CALL_CODE';
 End Call_New_Form;

 Procedure Run_Process is -- Call_Code = 'RUN xxxx'
 ------------------------
 Form_to_Run Varchar2(20);
 Begin
 If Length(Call_Code)=3 then --'RUN' is all there is.
 Form_To_Run:=Pk1.Call_Code;
 Elsif Substr(Call_Code,4,1)=' ' then
 Form_To_Run:=Ltrim(Substr(Call_Code,4));
 Else
 Call_New_Form; --call_code=RUNxxx
 Return;
 End if;
 Set_Globals;
 If Form_To_Run=QA then
 Build_Paramlist('R');
 call_form(Forms,QA,Asynchronous,
 Runtime,filesystem,'QAPARMS');
 Elsif Form_To_Run = 'HELP' then
 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface) <> 'WEB' then
 declare
 PId ParamList := Get_Parameter_List('QAHELP');
 begin
 If id_null(PId) then
 PId := Create_Parameter_List('QAHELP');
 Add_Parameter(PId,'HELP',Text_Parameter,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(PId,'Window_State',Text_Parameter,'Minimize');
 End if;
 call_form(Forms,null,Synchronous,Runtime,filesystem,PId);
 Destroy_Parameter_List(PID);
 end;
 End if;
 Message(' Runform version '
 ||get_application_Property(version)
 ,no_acknowledge);
 Else
 call_form(Forms,Form_To_Run,Asynchronous,
 Runtime,filesystem,to_char(null));
 End if;
 :B1.Call_Code:=Pk1.Call_Code;
 End Run_Process;

 Procedure Not_Connected is begin
 --------------------------------
 :B1.Call_Code:='LOGON';
 Pk1.Error_Item:='B1.CALL_CODE';
 IF ALERT_BUTTON2 -- ='EXIT QA'
 = SHOW_ALERT('CONNECT_OR_EXIT') THEN
 EXIT_FORM;
 END IF;
 End Not_Connected;

 Procedure Logon_Process is
 ------------------------
 CN Varchar2(30);
 UN Varchar2(30);
 PW Varchar2(50);
 Txt Varchar2(60);
 Begin
 :B1.Call_Code:=Pk1.Call_Code;
 If Call_Code not in ('LOGON','CONNECT') then
 If Call_Code in ('LOGON NEW','CONNECT NEW') then
 UN := Get_Application_Property(USERNAME);
 PW := Get_Application_Property(PASSWORD);
 CN := Get_Application_Property(CONNECT_STRING);
 If CN is not null then PW := PW||'@'||CN; End if;
 else
 Txt:=Substr(Call_Code,Instr(Call_Code,' ')+1);
 UN:=Substr(Txt,1,Instr(Txt,'/')-1);
 PW:=Substr(Txt,Length(UN)+2);
 End if;
 End if;
 U10_Clear_Form;
 QASQL.Close_Connection;
 Logout; -- Web 6i connect to db10g: no msgs between logout/logon
 Logon(UN,PW);
 If Form_Success then
 Delete_Group_Row('OWNER',ALL_ROWS);
 Set_Item_Property('B1.OWNER',LOV_Validation,Property_False);
 Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars := Null;
 Pk1.Setup_Tbl_Exists := Null;
 Pk1.Logon_OK := True;
 :Parameter.Usernam1 := Get_Application_Property(Username);
 :B1.Owner := :Parameter.Usernam1;
 Go_Item('B1.Owner');
 Validate(Item_Scope);
 P08_Get_MRU_List;--create MRU rec grp, may create QA_Setup tbl
 Message(' CONNECTION SUCCESSFUL. Username = '
 ||Get_Application_Property(USERNAME)||' Connected to '
 ||NVL(Get_Application_Property(CONNECT_STRING),'Default DB')
 ||' -- '||QASQL.DB_Version('New'),no_acknowledge);
 Else
 Pk1.Logon_OK := False;
 Not_Connected;
 End if;
 End Logon_Process;

Begin -- Main Process -------------------------------------------------*
 If not Pk1.Logon_OK
 and NVL(Call_Code,'Null') not in ('EXIT','LOGON','CONNECT') then
 Not_Connected;
 End if;
 If Call_Code is null then
 Call_Code := Pk1.Call_Code;
 :B1.Call_Code := Pk1.Call_Code;
 End If;
 IF Call_Code = 'EXIT' then
 Do_Key('EXIT_FORM');
 Elsif Substr(Call_Code,1,3)='RUN' then
 Run_Process;
 Elsif Call_Code = 'HELP'
 or Call_Code = 'ABOUT' then
 Call_code := 'RUN HELP';
 Run_Process;
 Elsif Substr(Call_Code,1,5)='LOGON'
 or Substr(Call_Code,1,7)='CONNECT' then
 Logon_Process;
 -- debugging code --
 Elsif Substr(Call_Code,1,6) = '*DEBUG' and Substr(Call_Code,-1)='*'
 then
 -- Store value in Pk1.Debug2
 Pk1.Debug2 := Call_Code; --value used in Key-Dup-Item trigger
 :B1.Call_Code := Pk1.Call_Code;-- on B1.Call_Code
 Else -- Call a new form
 Call_New_Form;
 End If;
End;

If get_Item_Property('B1.OWNER',ITEM_IS_VALID)='FALSE' then

If :B1.Call_Code is null then

--When-Validate-Item trigger on B1.Owner --*
Declare

 Procedure New_Owner is begin

 U10_CLEAR_FORM('START');
 Delete_Group_Row('TABLES',ALL_ROWS);
 Delete_Group_Row('VIEWS',ALL_ROWS);
 Delete_Group_Row('SYNONYMS',ALL_ROWS);

 End Loop;

 For Rec in (
 Select 'T' IND from dual where exists
 (select null from all_tables where owner=:b1.owner)
 union all
 Select 'V' IND from dual where exists
 (select null from all_views where owner=:b1.owner)
 union all

 (select null from all_synonyms s, all_objects o
 where :B1.Owner in(s.owner,s.table_owner)
 and s.table_owner=o.owner
 and s.table_name=o.object_name
 and o.object_type in('TABLE','VIEW'))
 ) loop
 ObjInd:=ObjInd||Rec.Ind;
 End Loop;
 End if;

 End New_Owner;

--When-Validate-Item trigger on B1.Table --*
-- If LOV was used to select a table or view, then the item does not
-- need further validation. If synonym was selected, or object name
-- was keyed-in then need to get its type: (Tbl, view or syn.).
-- Also for synonyms, need to determine the foundation table or view.
DECLARE
 LOV_Select_Used Boolean := Pk1.LOV_Select_Used;--Set True by P07
 Not_Fnd Boolean;
 Tbl_Owner Varchar2(30);
 Tbl_Name Varchar2(30);
 Tbl_Type Varchar2(10);
 STbl_Owner Varchar2(30);
 STbl_Name Varchar2(30);
 LoopCnt pls_integer := 0;

 Procedure Fail_Validate(Txt in Varchar2) is
 Tbl Varchar2(70);
 Begin
 U12_MSG_WORKING('CLEAR');
 If LOV_Select_Used then
 U01_Msge(' INVALID '||Txt||': '||Tbl_Owner||' . '||Tbl_Name);
 Else
 If :B1.Owner='PUBLIC' then
 Tbl:= :B1.Table;
 Else
 Tbl := :B1.Owner||' . '||:B1.Table;
 End if;
 U01_Msge(' '||Tbl||' IS NOT A VALID TABLE, VIEW OR SYNONYM'
 ||', OR IS NOT ACCESSIBLE');
 End if;
 End Fail_Validate;

 Procedure Try_partial_name is
 PG_num number;
 X number := 3.01; -- X, Y locations for Web
 Y number := 0.44;
 Val_chosen boolean;
 Procedure Pop_Grp is begin
 PG_num := Populate_group('PARTIAL_TBL_NAM');
 If PG_num not in(0, 1403) then
 U05_Alert_msg('Pop.Grp(PARTIAL_TBL_NAM): ',dbms_error_text);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 End;
 Begin
 If instr(Tbl_name,'%') > 0 then
 :Parameter.SQL_Bind_Var := Tbl_Name;
 Pop_Grp;
 Else
 :Parameter.SQL_Bind_Var := Tbl_Name || '%';
 Pop_Grp;
 If PG_num = 1403 then
 :Parameter.SQL_Bind_Var := '%' || Tbl_Name || '%';
 Pop_Grp;
 End if;
 End if;
 If PG_num = 0 then
 U12_MSG_WORKING('CLEAR');
 Set_LOV_Property('PARTIAL_TBL_NAM',Title,'Tables with name like '
 || :B2.Tbl_Actual );
 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface) <> 'WEB'then
 -- adjust X, Y for client/server
 X := X + Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,X_Pos);
 Y := Y + .22 + Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Y_Pos);
 End if;
 Val_chosen := Show_LOV('PARTIAL_TBL_NAM',X, Y);
 If Val_chosen then
 Tbl_Type := 'TABLE';
 Tbl_Name := :B1.Table;
 STbl_Name := Tbl_Name;
 U12_MSG_WORKING('BUSY');
 End if;
 End if;
 End Try_partial_name;

 Procedure Get_Synonym_Tbl is begin
 STbl_Name := null;
 -- Can have multiple records if owner.synonym and public syn
 -- are equal, but point to two different tables. This selects
 -- whichever comes up first.
 For R in
 (select distinct S.table_name,S.table_owner
 from all_synonyms s,all_objects o
 where ( :B1.Owner in(S.owner,S.table_owner)
 or user in(S.owner,S.table_owner))
 and s.table_owner=o.owner
 and s.table_name=o.object_name
 and o.object_type in('TABLE','VIEW','SYNONYM')
 and ( S.synonym_name<>S.table_name
 or :B1.Owner = 'PUBLIC' )
 and S.synonym_name=Tbl_Name ) Loop
 STbl_Owner := R.Table_Owner;
 STbl_Name := R.Table_Name;
 Tbl_Type := 'SYNONYM';
 exit;
 End loop;
 If STbl_Name is null then
 -- This uses Only All_Synonyms: When there is synonym of synonym,
 -- this method will work.
 For R in( Select Table_Owner,Table_Name
 from All_Synonyms
 where Owner in(Tbl_Owner,'PUBLIC')
 and Synonym_Name=Tbl_Name
 order by decode(Owner,'PUBLIC','B','A') ) Loop
 STbl_Owner := R.Table_Owner;
 STbl_Name := R.Table_Name;
 Tbl_Type := 'SYNONYM';
 exit;
 End loop;
 If STbl_Name is null then
 Try_partial_name;
 If STbl_Name is null then
 Fail_Validate('SYNONYM');
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End Get_Synonym_Tbl;

 Procedure Find_Tbl_Type is begin
 Tbl_Type := null; -- Can have multiple rows if there
 For R in( Select Table_Type -- is synonym w/same name as tbl
 from All_Catalog
 where Owner in(Tbl_Owner,'PUBLIC')
 and Table_Name=Tbl_Name
 and Table_Type in ('TABLE','VIEW','SYNONYM')
 order by decode(owner,'PUBLIC','B','A'),
 decode(Table_type,'SYNONYM','B','A') ) Loop
 Tbl_Type := R.Table_Type;
 exit;
 End loop;
 If Tbl_Type='SYNONYM'
 or Tbl_Type is null then -- Not found, so try Synonym lookup
 Get_Synonym_Tbl; -- Gets STbl_Name and STbl_Owner
 End if;
 End Find_Tbl_Type;

BEGIN
 Pk1.LOV_Select_Used := False;
 IF :B1.TABLE IS NULL THEN
 :B1.Table := Pk1.Table_Setup;
 Else
 :B1.Table := Replace(Ltrim(:B1.Table),' ','_');
 End if;
 If Nvl(:B1.Table,' ')<>Nvl(Pk1.Table_Setup,' ') then
 U12_MSG_WORKING('BUSY');
 Tbl_Name := :B1.Table;
 Tbl_Owner:= :B1.Owner;
 If LOV_Select_Used then
 Tbl_Type := Pk1.Tbl_Type;
 If Tbl_Type='SYNONYM' then
 STbl_Owner := :B2.Owner_Actual;
 STbl_Name := :B2.Tbl_Actual;
 End if;
 Else
 Find_Tbl_Type;
 Pk1.Tbl_Type := Tbl_Type;
 End if;
 -- Loop: can have synonym for synonym for table
 While Tbl_Type = 'SYNONYM' Loop
 Tbl_Name :=STbl_Name;
 Tbl_Owner:=STbl_Owner;
 -- Stop looping if public synonym points to non-accessible tbl
 LoopCnt := LoopCnt+1;
 If LoopCnt > 6 then
 U01_Msge(' PUBLIC SYNONYM '||Tbl_Name
 ||' EXISTS FOR NON-ACCESSIBLE TABLE '
 ||Tbl_Owner||'.'||Tbl_Name);
 End if;
 Find_Tbl_Type;
 End loop;
 :B2.Owner_Actual:=Tbl_Owner;
 :B2.Tbl_Actual :=Tbl_Name;
 P01_Setup_Form('START');
 End if;
Exception when others then --prevent loop in unexpected situations
 If sqlcode<>-100501 then --100501 from Raise FTF
 U05_Alert_Msg('Unexpected validation err:'||sqlcode,sqlerrm);
 End if;
 U12_MSG_WORKING('CLEAR');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;

End;

Declare

 Procedure Parse_the_Command is begin
 ------------------------------------
 CursNum := QASQL.Open_Cursor;
 QASQL.Parse(CursNum,Cmd||Where_Clause);
 Exception When Others then
 QASQL.Close_Cursor(CursNum,'OnCnt.E1');
 If sqlcode=-1031 then -- insufficient privileges
 U05_ALERT_MSG(QASQL.vSQLerrm);
 else
 U05_ALERT_MSG(' Error parsing Count: ',QASQL.vSQLerrm);
 U05_Alert_Msg('Statement in error: '||CMD||Where_Clause);
 end if;
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure;
 End Parse_the_Command;

BEGIN -- On-Count trigger

 ||:B2.Owner_Actual||'.'||:B2.Tbl_Actual;
 P04_BUILD_WHERE_CLAUSE(Where_Clause,Order_By);
 ---- Execute the count(*) select ----
 U12_MSG_WORKING;
 Parse_the_Command;
 QASQL.Define_Column(CursNum,1,TblData,20);
 Result := QASQL.Execute(CursNum);
 Result := QASQL.Fetch_Rows(CursNum);
 QASQL.Column_Value(CursNum,ColPos,TblData,ColErr,ColLen);
 QASQL.Close_Cursor(CursNum,'OnCnt');
 Set_Block_Property('D',QUERY_HITS,To_Number(TblData)); 
EXCEPTION When Others then
 If SQLerrm = 'User-Defined Exception'
 or SQLCode = -100501 then--From Raise F_T_F above, so skip.

 Procedure Fetch_a_Row is begin
 ------------------------------
 Pk1.Fetch_Row_Cnt := Pk1.Fetch_Row_Cnt + 1;
 Begin

 Exception when others then

 ||Pk1.Fetch_Row_Cnt||'. Only 4000 bytes can be retrieved'
 ||' when rowid is not accessible. Query terminated.');

 End if;
 End;

 Elsif Pk1.Fetch_Result > 0 then
 Begin

 ExitFlag := True;

 Create_Queried_Record;

 End If;
 End Fetch_a_Row;

 Procedure Create_Select_Cmd (CMD in out Varchar2) is
 ---------------------------
 AddTxt varchar2(70);

 MaxData := 19;

 U05_Alert_Msg(' On-Select error: ','Columns are UNDEFINED');
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure;
 ElsIf Data_Type in ('DATE','NUMBER') then
 AddTxt := 'TO_CHAR('||Col_Name||')';
 AddFR := Col_Name;
 If Data_Type ='DATE' then
 MaxData := MaxData + 15;
 Else --number
 MaxData := MaxData + 3 + nvl(Pk1.Precisn,Pk1.DataLen);
 End if;
 Elsif Data_Type = 'LONG' then
 AddTxt := 'NULL';
 AddFR := 'to_char(null) as '||Col_Name;

 Else -- Data_Type in('VARCHAR2','CHAR','RAW','ROWID',etc.)
 AddTxt := Col_Name;
 AddFR := Col_Name;

 End If;
 CMD := CMD||ETX||AddTxt;
 FatRow_Qry := FatRow_Qry ||comma|| AddFR;
 ColNum := ColNum + 1;
 comma := ',';
 if mod(ColI,5)=0 then comma:=','||chr(10); end if;
 Exit when ColNum >= Pk1.Max_Col;
 End if;
 End Loop;
 CMD := CMD||' FROM '||:B2.Owner_Actual||'.'||:B2.Tbl_Actual;
 If not id_null(Pk1.FatRow_RG) then
 Delete_group(Pk1.FatRow_RG);
 Pk1.FatRow_RG := null;
 End if;
 If MaxData > MaxData_limit then
 -- Use rec group --
 FatRow_Qry := FatRow_Qry
 ||' FROM '||:B2.Owner_Actual||'.'||:B2.Tbl_Actual
 ||' WHERE ROWID=:D.ROWID';

 Procedure Edit_Numbers is
 -------------------------
 Hi Number;

 N Number;
 N_Abs Number;

 Precis Number := Pk1.Precisn;

 Ds Varchar2(1) := substr(Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars,1,1);
 DL Varchar2(1) := substr(Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars_Loc,1,1);
 Begin
 -- in F45, Local Grp separator (,) can interfere with the
 -- Replace inside the To_number below, so check first.
 If Replace(Data_Val,substr(Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars_Loc,1,1),
 substr(Pk1.NLS_Num_Chars,1,1)) <> Data_Val then
 U01_Msge(' INVALID NUMBER');
 End if;
 Begin
 -- replace Session decimal char (Ds) with Loc decimal (DL).
 -- In Forms45, Loc decimal is always '.' but in F6, it's = Ds
 N := To_Number(Replace(Data_Val,Ds,DL));
 Exception When others then
 If Precis is null and Scale is null then
 U01_Msge(' INVALID NUMBER');
 Else
 U01_Msge(' INVALID NUMBER. FORMAT IS NUMBER('
 ||To_Char(nvl(Precis,Pk1.DataLen))
 ||','||To_Char(Scale)||')');
 End If;
 End;
 If Precis is null
 and Scale is null then
 N_New := N;
 Else
 N_New := Round(N,Scale); --Removes trailing decimal digits
 If N <> 0 Then -- if necessary
 -- Determine max possible value
 Lo:=Power(10,-scale);
 Hi:=Lo*To_Number(Substr('9999999999999999999999',
 1,nvl(Precis,Pk1.DataLen) ));
 N_Abs := ABS(N_New);
 If N_Abs > Hi then
 -- Subtract amount over max. value --
 LH_Sum:=Lo+Hi;
 N_New:=Sign(N)*(N_Abs-LH_Sum*Trunc(N_Abs/LH_Sum));
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 N_Txt := Replace(To_Char(N_New),DL,Ds);
 If N_Txt <> Data_Val then
 Copy(N_Txt,:System.Trigger_Item);
 End If;
 If N_New<>N then
 U01_Msge(' VALUE CHANGED TO MATCH COLUMN DEFINITION.'

 Procedure Format_Col_Title IS
 Col_Ctr Number;
 Col_Name_Len Number;
 Col_Title Varchar2(40);
 Data_Width_Adj Number;
 Gstr Number;
 Hdng_Width Number;
 PairLen Number;
 Part Varchar2(32);
 PartCnt Number;
 LnCnt Number :=0;
 Strt Number;
 TmpWidth Number;
 UndSc Number;

 Procedure Join_Heading_Parts is
 ------------------------------------
 UndSc2 Number;
 Begin
 -- join heading parts if data width is wide enough --
 -- (changes some underscores to spaces)
 Strt := 1;
 Loop
 UndSc := Instr(Col_Name,'_',Strt);
 Exit when UndSc=0;
 UndSc2 := Instr(Col_Name,'_',UndSc+1);
 If UndSc2=0 then
 UndSc2 := Col_Name_Len + 1;
 End if;
 If (1+UndSc2-Strt)*Hdng_Const<=Data_Width_Adj then
 Col_Name := Substr(Col_Name,1,Strt-1)
 ||Replace(Substr(Col_Name,Strt,UndSc2-Strt),'_',' ')
 ||Substr(Col_Name,UndSc2);
 else
 Strt := UndSc + 1;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End Join_Heading_Parts;
 --
 Procedure Get_Part_Lengths is
 -----------------------------
 Part_Len Number;
 Prev_Part_Len Number := 0;
 Begin
 -- find longest, shortest strings
 Gstr := 0;
 Strt := 1;
 PartCnt := 0;
 PairLen := 99;
 Loop
 UndSc := Instr(Col_Name,'_',Strt);
 If UndSc=0 then
 UndSc:=Col_Name_Len+1;
 End if;
 Part := Substr(Col_Name,Strt,UndSc-Strt);
 Part_Len := Length(Part);
 PartCnt := PartCnt + 1;
 Strt := UndSc + 1;
 Gstr := greatest(Gstr,Part_Len);
 If PartCnt > 1 then
 PairLen := Least(PairLen,Prev_Part_Len+2+Part_Len);
 End if;
 Prev_Part_Len := Part_Len;
 exit when Strt>Col_Name_Len;
 End loop;
 End Get_Part_Lengths;
 --
 Procedure Split_Long_String is
 ------------------------------
 -- Hyphenate long title string
 Begin
 Strt := 1;
 Loop
 UndSc := Instr(Col_Name,'_',Strt);
 If UndSc=0 then
 UndSc:=Col_Name_Len+1;
 End if;
 Part := Substr(Col_Name,Strt,UndSc-Strt);
 If Length(Part)=Gstr then
 Part := Substr(Part,1,Trunc(Gstr/2))||'-_'
 ||Substr(Part,1+Trunc(Gstr/2));
 Col_Name := Substr(Col_Name,1,Strt-1)||Part
 ||Substr(Col_Name,UndSc);
 Col_Name_Len := Col_Name_Len + 2;
 Exit;
 End if;
 Exit when UndSc >= Col_Name_Len;
 Strt := UndSc + 1;
 End loop;
 End Split_Long_String;
 --
 Procedure Build_Col_Heading is
 ------------------------------------
 -- Create a Column Title from the DBMS Column Name
 ----
 Loop_Cntr Number := 0;
 Begin
 Data_Width_Adj := Greatest(Data_Width, Min_Col_Wid,
 (1+Col_Name_Len)*Hdng_Const*.28);
 Loop -- loop until only 4 heading 'parts' (3 underscores)
 Join_Heading_Parts;
 Exit when 4 > Col_Name_Len - Length(Replace(Col_Name,'_'));
 Loop_Cntr := Loop_Cntr + 1;
 If Loop_Cntr = 1 then
 Get_Part_Lengths;
 If PairLen < 99 then
 Data_Width_Adj:=Greatest(Data_Width_Adj,PairLen*Hdng_Const);
 End if;
 Else
 Data_Width_Adj := Data_Width_Adj + Hdng_Const;
 End if;
 End loop;
 --
 Get_Part_Lengths;
 Hdng_Width := (1+Gstr)*Hdng_Const;
 If Hdng_Width>2*data_width
 and PartCnt < 4
 and Gstr>14 then
 Split_Long_String;
 end if;
 ----
 Hdng_Width := 0;
 Strt := 1;
 Loop
 UndSc := Instr(Col_Name,'_',Strt);
 If UndSc=0 then
 UndSc:=Col_Name_Len+1;
 End if;
 Part := SUBSTR(Col_Name,Strt,UndSc-Strt);
 TmpWidth:=(1+Length(Part))*Hdng_Const;
 Hdng_Width:=Greatest(Hdng_Width,TmpWidth);
 Strt:=UndSc+1;
 LnCnt:=LnCnt+1;
 Col_Title:=Col_Title||Part||chr(3);
 exit when Strt>Col_Name_Len or LnCnt>3;
 End Loop;
 Col_Title:=InitCap(Col_Title);--First Ltr Upper, others lower
 Strt := instr(Col_Title,'-');
 If Strt > 0 then
 Col_Title:=Substr(Col_Title,1,Strt+1)
 ||Lower(Substr(Col_Title,Strt+2,1))
 ||Substr(Col_Title,Strt+3);
 End if;
 If LnCnt>1 then
 Go_Record(5-LnCnt);
 End if;
 Strt := 1;
 Loop
 UndSc := Instr(Col_Title,chr(3),Strt);
 Copy(Substr(Col_Title,Strt,UndSc-Strt),Title_Nam);
 Strt:=UndSc+1;
 Exit when :System.Cursor_Record='4';
 Next_Record;
 End Loop;
 End Build_Col_Heading;
 --
 --
 Begin -- Format_Col_Title
 -------------------------
 Col_Name := Rtrim(Col_Name,'_'); --remove extra underscores
 Loop
 exit when instr(Col_Name,'__') = 0;
 Col_Name := replace(Col_Name,'__','_');
 End loop;
 Col_Name_Len := Length(Col_Name);
 If (1+Col_Name_Len)*Hdng_Const>Greatest(Data_Width,Min_Col_Wid) then
 Build_Col_Heading;
 else -- single line title on record 4
 Hdng_Width := (1+Col_Name_Len)*Hdng_Const;
 Copy(InitCap(Replace(Col_Name,'_',' ')),Title_Nam);
 End if;

 --- Position Title item and Data item on canvas ---
 Col_Ctr := Greatest(Col_PosT+Hdng_Width/2,Col_PosD+Data_Width/2);
 Tmp := Width_Btw_Cols+Col_Ctr + Greatest(Hdng_Width/2,Data_Width/2);
 If Canvas1_Width<Tmp then
 Canvas1_Width:=Tmp+5;
 Set_Canvas_Property(Canvas1_Id,Width,Canvas1_Width);
 End if;
 Tmp := Col_Ctr - Hdng_Width/2;
 Set_Item_Property(Title_Id,Position,Tmp,Y_Posn_Title);
 If not Form_Success then
 U01_Msge(' (P01) Set Title Position failed, item='||Title_Nam
 ||' XPos='||Tmp||' CnvWid='||Canvas1_Width);
 End if;
 Set_Item_Property(Title_Id,Width,Hdng_Width);
 If not Form_Success then
 U01_Msge(' (P01) Set width failed, item='||Title_Nam );
 End if;
 Tmp := Col_Ctr - Data_Width/2;
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Position,Tmp,Y_Posn_Data);
 If not Form_Success then
 U01_Msge(' (P01) Set Data Position failed, item='||Title_Nam
 ||' XPos='||Tmp ||' CnvWid='||Canvas1_Width);
 End if;
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Width,Data_Width);
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Displayed,Property_True);
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Enabled,Property_True);
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Navigable,Property_True);
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Queryable,Property_True);
 If Pk1.Display_Only='F' then
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Updateable,Property_True);
 End if;
 Declare CR varchar2(1)
 :=Substr(Get_Item_Property(Data_Id,Case_Restriction),1,1);
 CR_p varchar2(1):= Substr(:Parameter.Case_Restriction,1,1);
 Begin
 IF CR <> CR_p then
 If CR_p='N' then
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Case_Restriction,None);
 elsif CR_p='L' then
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Case_Restriction,Lowercase);
 else
 Set_Item_Property(Data_Id,Case_Restriction,Uppercase);
 end if;
 End if;
 End;
 Col_PosT := Width_Btw_Cols + Col_Ctr + Hdng_Width/2;
 Col_PosD := Width_Btw_Cols + Col_Ctr + Data_Width/2;
 End Format_Col_Title;

Procedure P02_SET_VIEW_WIDTHS (Mode1 in Varchar2 := null) is -- QA --*

Begin

 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface)= 'WEB' then

 -- gives the entire width, including the frame.

 End if;
 Set_View_Property('TOP',width,Wid_MDI);

 If CnvWid+.42 > Wid_MDI -- canvas wider than mdi window
 or Pk1.Table_Setup is null -- or no table setup
 or Mode1='WNFI' then
 -- Canvas wider than will fit in mdi (or no tbl setup).

 Set_View_Property('CANVAS1',Display_X_Pos,.06);
 Set_View_Property('CANVAS1',width,Wid_MDI-.42);
 Set_View_Property('SCROLLBAR',Display_X_Pos,Wid_MDI-.30);
 if Pk1.Table_Setup is null then

 end if;
 Elsif CnvWid > 6.2 then --CnvWid+.42 is < Wid_MDI

 Set_View_Property('CANVAS1',Display_X_Pos,.06);

 Set_View_Property('CANVAS1',Display_X_Pos,CnvX_Pos);

 End if;

PROCEDURE P04_BUILD_WHERE_CLAUSE
 (Where_Clause in out varchar2,Order_By in out varchar2) is
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
-- Used by On-Select and On-Count triggers
-- Gets Where Clause and Order By clauses from the form's query.
-- Translates Where Clause into usable text
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
 Procedure Build_WC (WC IN OUT Varchar2) is
 ------------------------------------------
 Col Varchar2(4); -- D01 thru D100
 Colx Varchar2(1); -- extra 0 in D100
 ColxLen Integer := 3; -- Len of Col (3 or 4)
 Col_Name Varchar2(32);
 ColNum Integer;
 ColVal Varchar2(300);
 ColValFmt Varchar2(300);
 Cond Varchar2(400);
 Data_Type Varchar2(30);
 LP Integer;
 MaxLen Integer := NVL(Length(WC),0);
 Oper Varchar2(30);
 P1 Integer;
 P2 Integer;
 WC2 Varchar2(1000);
 WC_And Varchar2(10);

 Procedure Format_Date is
 ---------------------
 d date;
 dtxt varchar2(20);
 fmt varchar2(30) := 'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS';
-- len integer := Length(ColVal);
 OK_Date Boolean;
 Begin
 U04_Check_Date(ColVal,OK_Date,d,dtxt,'D3YT');
 IF OK_Date then
 If Substr(dtxt,13,9)='00:00:00' then
 fmt := Substr(fmt,1,11);
 dtxt := Substr(dtxt,1,11);
 End If;
-- If Len=9 then fmt := 'DD-MON-YY';
-- Elsif Len=10 then fmt := 'MM/DD/YYYY';
-- Else fmt := 'MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS';
-- End if;
 ColValFmt := 'TO_DATE('''||dtxt||''','''||fmt||''')';
-- d := to_date(colval,fmt);
-- Exception when others then
 Else
 U05_Alert_Msg(' Invalid date in '||Col_Name
 ||' in example record. Query not issued.');
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 End If;
 End Format_Date;

 Procedure Check_Number is
 -----------------------
 N Number;
 Begin
 N := To_Number(ColVal);
 Exception when others then
 U05_Alert_Msg(' Invalid number in '||Col_Name
 ||' in example record. Query not issued.');
 Raise form_trigger_failure;
 End Check_Number;

 Procedure Translate_Condition (Cond in out Varchar2) is
 -----------------------------
 -- Creates one conditional phrase for Where Clause.
 -- Input is cond. phrase (examples) 
 -- (D01=:1) (D02<>:10) (D03 in (1,2,3)) (D04<>'ab')
 -- or (D03 anything) and (special conds)
 -- Output: Cond
 -- (COLNAME1=123), (COL2<>'Text Value'), (C3 in (1,2,3)), (C4<>'ab')
 -- (C3 anything) and (special conds)
 C1 Integer;
 Begin
 If not ( Substr(Cond,2,1)='D'
 And Substr(Cond,3,1) between '0' and '9'
 And Substr(Cond,4,1) between '0' and '9') then
 -- Special cond entered into the Query/Where window
 Null;
 Else
 Col := Substr(Cond,2,3);
 Colx := Substr(Cond,5,1);
 If Colx between '0' and '9' then
 Col := Col||Colx;
 ColxLen := 4;
 End if;
 ColNum := To_Number(Substr(Col,2));
 if ColNum > Pk1.Column_Count then
 Cond := null;
 else
 Pk1.Get_Row_X(ColNum);
 Col_Name := Pk1.ColName;
 If upper(Col_Name)<>Col_Name then
 Col_Name := '"'||Col_Name||'"';
 End if;
 Data_Type := Pk1.DataTyp;
 --Look for ':1)' at end of cond
 C1 := Instr(Substr(Cond,-4),':');
 If C1=0 then
 -- Bind var. format (eg :1) not found, so use entire cond.
 -- This type entered using #. Example: #in (1,2,3)
 Cond:='('||Col_Name||Substr(Cond,2+ColxLen);
 Else
 Oper := Substr(Cond,2+ColxLen,
 NVL(Length(Cond),0)+C1-6-ColxLen);
 ColVal := Name_In('D.'||Col);
 --Remove operator from ColVal if it is there.
 -- Example >123 in ColVal returns >:1 in clause
 If Substr(ColVal,1,NVL(Length(Oper),0)) = Oper then
 ColVal:=LTrim(Substr(ColVal,Nvl(Length(Oper),0)+1));
 End If;
 --
 If Data_Type = 'DATE' then
 Format_Date;
 ElsIf Data_Type = 'NUMBER' then
 Check_Number;
 ColValFmt := ColVal;
 Else -- Data_Type is 'VARCHAR2' or 'CHAR'
 ColValFmt := ''''||ColVal||'''';
 End If;
 Cond := '('||Col_Name||Oper||ColValFmt||')';
 End If;
 End If;
 End If;
 End Translate_Condition;

 BEGIN -- Build_WC ---------------------------------------------------*
 P1 := 0;
 WC2 := Null;
 WC_And := ' WHERE ';
 Loop
 --Locate left paren--beginning of a conditional phrase.
 P2 := Instr(Substr(WC,P1+1),'(');
 Exit when NVL(P2,0)=0;
 P1 := P1+P2;
 LP := P1; --save left paren loc.
 --Locate ending right paren. This relies on fact that each cond
 --is separated from next by ) and (
 P2 := Instr(Substr(WC,P1+1),') and (');
 If NVL(P2,0)=0 then
 P1:=MaxLen;
 Else
 P1 := P1+P2; -- P1 should be on right paren.
 End If;
 Cond := Substr(WC,LP,P1-LP+1);
 Translate_Condition(Cond);
 if cond is not null then
 WC2 := WC2||WC_And||Cond;
 WC_And := ' and ';
 end if;
 End Loop;
 WC := WC2;
 END Build_WC;

Begin -- Main Process -------------------------------------------------*
 Declare P Integer;
 Begin
 ---- Get 'order by' clause ----
 P := Instr(:System.Last_Query,' order by ');
 If P>0 then
 Order_By := Substr(:System.Last_Query,P);
 End If;
 ---- Get where clause ----
 P := Instr(:System.Last_Query,' WHERE ');
 If P>0 then
 Where_Clause := Substr(:System.Last_Query,P+1);
 -- Remove 'Order by' clause from the end --
 If Order_By is not null then
 Where_Clause := Substr(Where_Clause,1,
 Nvl(Length(Where_Clause),0)-Nvl(Length(Order_By),0));
 End If;
 Build_WC(Where_Clause);
 End If;
 End;
End P04_Build_Where_Clause;

PACKAGE PK2 IS -- --*
-- PK2 enables drag and drop of the column name field on the ATC block.
 MseBtnDwn Boolean := False;
 New_Rec Boolean := False; --Set by ATC.WNRI trigger
 Procedure End_Drag;
 Procedure Timer1;
 Procedure WMD;
 Procedure WMU;
END;

PACKAGE BODY PK2 IS -- --*
-- PK2 enables drag and drop of the column name field on the ATC block
-- so the columns can be ordered manually.
-- Procedures WMD, WMU, and WMM are called by When-Mouse-Down, WM-Up
-- and WM-Move triggers.
 Shadow Item := Find_Item('B2.COLUMN_NAME_SHADOW');
 Column Item := Find_Item('ATC.COLUMN_NAME');
 Col_X Number := Get_Item_Property(Column,X_Pos);
 Col_Y Number := Get_Item_Property(Column,Y_Pos);
 Col_L Number := Get_Item_Property(Column,Width);
 Col_H Number := Get_Item_Property(Column,Height);
 CurRow Integer; -- Current row mouse is on: First=1. Can be -1, 0
 -- or > last row to enable scrolling.
 MRow Integer;
 MouseRec Integer;
 MouseRx Boolean := False;
 SloScroll Integer := 0;
 ROffset Integer; --Which row mouse-down begins on. Calc by wmd. 
 S_Top Number := Col_Y-2*Col_H;
 S_Bot Number := To_Number(Get_View_Property('ATC',Height))
 - Col_H;
 SY_Old Number := 0;
 TmId Timer;
 ATC Block := Find_Block('ATC');
 AtcRecs Integer := Get_Block_Property(ATC,Records_Displayed);
 WMD_Rec Integer; -- Rec# of row when Mouse-Down starts.
 WMD_Y Number;

 Function TopRec Return integer is begin
 ---------------
 Return to_number(Get_Block_Property(ATC,Top_Record));
 End TopRec;

 Procedure WMD is begin
 ----------------------
 -- When-Mouse-Down Process
 If :system.cursor_record> Pk1.Column_Count
 or New_Rec then --Set by ATC.WNRI trigger
 New_Rec := False;
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure;
 End if;
 MseBtnDwn := True;
 WMD_Y := :System.Mouse_Y_Pos;
 WMD_Rec := :system.cursor_record;
 ROffset := WMD_Rec - TopRec;
 Display_Item(Column,'WHITE_ON_BLACK');
 :B2.COLUMN_NAME_SHADOW := :ATC.COLUMN_NAME;
 Set_Item_Property(Shadow,Position,Col_X,Col_Y+Col_H*ROffset);
 Set_Item_Property(Shadow,Displayed,Property_True);
 --Set_Item_Property(Shadow,Enabled,Property_True);--not txt itm.
 If get_application_property(User_interface)<>'WEB' then
 U02_Start_Timer('PK2_TIMER1',15,'REPEAT');
 TmId := Find_Timer('PK2_TIMER1');
 End if;
 MouseRec := :system.mouse_record;
 MouseRx := False;
 PK2.TIMER1; --force to execute once
 End WMD;

 Procedure End_Drag is begin
 ------------------------------
 MseBtnDwn := False;
 Set_Item_Property(Shadow,Displayed,Property_False);
 -- Need to find timer because it can disappear after a right-click
 TmId := Find_Timer('PK2_TIMER1');
 If not Id_null(TmId) then
 Delete_Timer(TmId);
 End if;
 End End_Drag;

 Procedure WMU is
 ----------------
 -- When-Mouse-Up Process --
 New_Top integer;
 WMU_Rec integer;
 Begin
 If MseBtnDwn then
 End_Drag;
 If CurRow not between 1 and AtcRecs
 or CurRow > Pk1.Column_Count + 1
 or :System.Mouse_X_Pos not between 0 and Col_L then
 -- mouse out of bounds --
 Display_Item(Column,'CURRENTITEM');
 else
 New_Top := TopRec;
 WMU_Rec := New_Top + CurRow - 1;
 If WMD_Rec < New_Top then
 New_Top := New_Top-1;
 End if;
 Go_record(WMU_Rec);
 Go_item('ATC.COLUMN_NAME');
 If WMU_Rec not in (WMD_Rec,WMD_Rec+1) then
 Pk1.Move_Row(WMD_Rec,WMU_Rec);
 End if;
 If TopRec > New_Top then
 Go_Record(New_Top);
 Elsif TopRec < New_Top then
 Go_Record(New_Top+AtcRecs-1);
 End if;
 Synchronize;
 If WMD_Rec < WMU_Rec then
 Go_Record(WMU_Rec - 1);
 Else
 Go_Record(WMU_Rec);
 End if;
 End if;
 If :System.record_status='NEW' then
 Previous_Record; --remove blank row at bottom
 End if;
 End if;
 End WMU;

 Procedure Scroll is
 -------------------
 -- Scrolls the block one unit (Unit depends on mouse position).
 -- Called by Scroll_Process below.
 Begin
 SloScroll:=Mod(SloScroll+1,4); -- SloScroll alternates 0,1,2,3
 If MRow < 1 then
 If MRow=0 then
 If SloScroll=0 then
 Previous_Record;
 End if;
 Elsif MRow > -3 then
 Previous_Record;
 Elsif SloScroll=0 then
 Go_Record(Greatest(To_Number(:System.cursor_Record)-8,1));
 End if;
 Else
 If MRow = AtcRecs+1 then
 If SloScroll=0 then
 Next_Record;
 End if;
 Elsif MRow < AtcRecs+4 then
 Next_Record;
 Elsif SloScroll=0 then
 Go_Record(Least(To_Number(:System.cursor_Record)+7,
 Pk1.Column_Count));
 Next_Record;
 End if;
 End if;
 MouseRx := True;
 End Scroll;

 Procedure Timer1 is
 -------------------
 -- This process is called recursively by WTE trigger. The timer is
 -- started by WMD. This process moves the shadow item up and down.
 MX Number; -- Mouse X pos.
 MY Number; -- Mouse Y pos.
 SY Number; -- Y pos. of Shadow item
 TopRec1 Integer;
 Begin
 If not MseBtnDwn then
 Return;
 End if;
 MX := :System.Mouse_X_Pos;
 MY := :System.Mouse_Y_Pos;
 SY := least(greatest(Col_Y+Col_H*ROffset+MY-WMD_Y,S_Top),S_Bot);
 If MX not between 0 and Col_L then
 Set_Timer(TmId,15,REPEAT);-- Fast so Shadow moves smoothly
 Return; --No scrolling if cursor out of range
 Elsif SY_Old<>SY then
 SY_Old := SY;
 Set_Item_Property(Shadow,Position,Col_X,SY);
 Synchronize;
 CurRow:=round((SY_Old-Col_Y)/Col_H)+1;
 End if;
 If MouseRx then
 MouseRec := :system.mouse_record;
 MouseRx := False;
 elsif MouseRec <> :system.mouse_record then
 End_Drag; -- right click used during drag operation.
 end if;
 If CurRow not between 1 and AtcRecs then
 MRow:=round((Col_Y+Col_H*ROffset+MY-WMD_Y-Col_Y)/Col_H)+1;
 Set_Timer(TmId,30,REPEAT); --slow down for scrolling
 If CurRow<1 then
 --- scroll up if cursor above first row ---
 TopRec1 := TopRec;
 If TopRec1>1 then
 If to_number(:System.cursor_record) > TopRec1 then
 go_record(TopRec1);
 End if;
 Scroll;
 Else
 MouseRx:=True;
 End if;
 Else
 --- scroll down if cursor below last displayed row ---
 TopRec1 := TopRec;
 If Pk1.Column_Count > TopRec1 + AtcRecs - 2 then
 If to_number(:System.cursor_record) < TopRec1+AtcRecs-1 then
 go_record(TopRec1+AtcRecs-1);
 End if;
 Scroll;
 Else
 MouseRx:=True;
 End if;
 End if;
 End if;
 End Timer1;
END PK2;

PROCEDURE U04_Check_Date
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Used by WVI and WNII triggers, and P04_Bld_Where_Clause.
-- Verifies date and re-displays date using a standard format.
--
-- Checks D_Txt to determine whether it is a valid date.
-- OK_Date is returned True or False.
-- D is the date in Oracle Date format
-- D_Txt2 is the date formatted according to FmtInd.
-- FmtInd values:
-- D3YT returns DD-MON-YYYY HH:MI:SS
-- MDYX returns MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS, but truncates time if all zeros
-- (MDYX is set according to :Parameter.Date_Format)
-- Time is always 24-hour time.
-- If century is not specified in input date, it is inferred using the
-- sliding-100-Year+10 method
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
 (D_Txt in Varchar2,
 OK_Date out Boolean,
 D out Date,
 D_Txt2 out Varchar2,
 FmtInd in Varchar2)
 is
 len integer := Nvl(length(D_Txt),0);
 fmt varchar2(30);
 fix_cent boolean := false;
 -- :Parameter.date_format is 'MM/DD/YYYY' (DD.MM.YYYY for European)
 df6 varchar2(6) := substr(:parameter.date_format,1,6);
 df4 varchar2(4) := substr(df6,1,2)||substr(df6,4,2);
 spc integer := instr(D_Txt,' ');
 dx date := to_date('02292000','MMDDYYYY');
Begin
 If spc > 6 then
 Len := spc-1;
 End If;
 If Len = 8 then
 If Substr(D_Txt,3,1) in('/','-','.') then
 fmt := df6||'YY';
 fix_cent:=true;
 Else
 fmt := df4||'YYYY';
 End If;
 Elsif Len = 10 then fmt := df6||'YYYY';
 Elsif Len = 9 then fmt := 'DD-MON-YY'; fix_cent:=true;
 Elsif Len = 6 then fmt := df4||'YY'; fix_cent:=true;
 Else fmt := 'DD-MON-YYYY';
 End If;
 If spc>6 then
 fmt := fmt||' HH24:MI:SS';
 End If;
 begin
 d := to_date(D_Txt,fmt);
 exception when others then
 if sqlcode<>-1839 then raise;
 else begin -- Y2K fix: old Forms versions fail on 022900
 select to_date(D_Txt,replace(fmt,'YY','RR')) into d from dual;
 exception when others then raise; end;
 end if;
 end;
 If fix_cent then
 If Pk1.Yr_Num is null then
 Pk1.Yr_Num := To_Number(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY'));
 End If;
 Declare Yr_Num Integer; CC Varchar2(2);
 Begin
 Yr_Num := Pk1.Yr_Num-90;
 If Substr(D_Txt,Len-1,2)>Substr(To_Char(Yr_Num),3,2) then
 CC := Substr(To_Char(Yr_Num),1,2);
 Else
 CC := Substr(To_Char(Yr_Num+100),1,2);
 End If;
 d := To_Date(CC||To_Char(d,'YYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS');
 End;
 End If;
 If FmtInd='D3YT' then
 D_Txt2 := To_Char(d,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS');
 Elsif FmtInd='MDYX' then
 D_Txt2 := To_Char(d,df6||'YYYY HH24:MI:SS');
 If Substr(D_Txt2,11,9)=' 00:00:00' then
 D_Txt2 := Substr(D_Txt2,1,10);
 End If;
 End If;
 OK_Date := TRUE;
Exception when others then
 OK_Date := FALSE;
End U04_Check_Date;

PROCEDURE U05_ALERT_MSG -- --*
 (PreFix in Varchar2,
 Msg in Varchar2 default Null) is
-- Displays a message in an alert box. Use "stacked message" method
-- since it displays more text (255 characters) than an alert (200 max).
-- If message is longer than 255 characters, displays as multiple
-- messages so entire message is displayed.
 --
 L pls_integer;
 ltrm boolean := true;
 Cnt pls_integer;
 sep varchar2(10);
 M2 varchar2(3000) := substr(Msg,1,3000);
 --
 Procedure CleanUp_Msg(txt in varchar2) is begin
 L := Instr(M2,txt,20,1);
 If L>0 then
 M2 := Substr(M2,1,L-1);
 End if;
 End CleanUp_Msg;
 -- 
 Function trans(m_in in varchar2)
 --------------
 -- This function ensures new line characters are handled properly.
 -- replaces linefeed [chr(10)] and Carriage Return [chr(13)] chars
 -- as necessary depending on where form is running (Web
 -- or client/server).
 --------------
 return varchar2 is
 m varchar2(300) := m_in;
 begin
 -- Modify end-of-line characters, depending on WEB or client/server
 -- and whether using alert or stacked message.
 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface) = 'WEB' then
 -- old web forms 6: chr(138) is new line
 -- not forms 6: use single space for long msg, 
 -- or six spaces if not too long.
 m := translate(m, chr(10)||chr(13), chr(138)||chr(138) );
 m := replace(m, chr(138)||chr(138), chr(138));
 if sep <> chr(138) then
 m := replace(m, chr(138), sep);
 end if;
 else -- Client/server message: chr(13) is new line
 m := replace(m, chr(10), chr(13));
 m := replace(m, chr(13)||chr(13), chr(13));
 end if;
 -- ltrim first set only
 if ltrm then
 m := ltrim(m);
 ltrm := false;
 end if;
 return m;
 end trans;
 ---
 Procedure stacked_messages(msg2 varchar2) is
 --------------------------
 mtxt varchar2(300);
 P pls_integer := 1;
 Begin
 loop exit when P > L;
 If L - P <= 254 then
 mtxt := substr(msg2,p);
 P := P + 255;
 Else
 mtxt := substr(msg2,p,252) || '...';
 P := P + 252;
 End if;
 Message(trans(mtxt));
 end loop;
 Message(' ',no_acknowledge); --forces message into an alert box.
 End stacked_messages;
 ---
BEGIN
 -- If DBMS_SQL error, remove "error at line...' messages.
 -- DBMS_SQL errors have multiple 06512 or 06550 "error at line#"
 -- messages following the first error. If there are any of these,
 -- they are removed here.
 If Instr(M2,'DBMS_SQL') > 0 then
 CleanUp_Msg('ORA-06512');
 CleanUp_Msg('ORA-06550');
 End if;
 --
 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface) = 'WEB'
 and substr(get_application_Property(version),1,1) <> '6' then
 --web forms > 6, no new-line available, convert to spaces
 L := nvl(length(M2),0);
 Cnt := L - length(translate(M2,'+'||chr(10)||chr(13),'+'));
 If L + 5*Cnt > 3000 then -- Long message, so use single space
 sep := ' '; -- to replace new-line
 Else
 sep := ' '; --six spaces
 M2 := replace(M2, chr(13), chr(10));
 M2 := replace(M2, chr(10)||chr(10), chr(10));
 M2 := replace(M2, chr(10), sep);
 End if;
 Else -- Client/server or Web Forms6
 sep := chr(138); -- sep is not used above if client/server
 End if;
 L := nvl(Length(PreFix||M2),0);
 stacked_messages(PreFix||M2);
END;

Function U09_Apost_Pad(Txt in Varchar2) Return Varchar2 is --*
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Replaces each apostrophe in a text string with two.
 A Varchar2(1) := ''''; -- One apostrophe
 AA Varchar2(2) := ''''''; -- Two apostrophes
 L Integer := Nvl(Length(Txt),0);
 P1 Integer := 1;
 P2 Integer;
 Txt2 Varchar2(4100);
Begin

Procedure Check_Cleanup_Order_By (Mode1 in out integer) is
------------------------------------------------------
-- Mode1: 0=no msg, cleanup, use low-num group. (from P01)
-- 1=check, using high-num group, msg if in error.
-- Mode1 is changed from 1 to 2 if re-display of ATC is required (this
-- is necessary if in the 'Store' button process.
 A Integer := Mode1 * Pk1.Column_Count;
 C Varchar2(10);
 Change_Req Boolean;
 L Number;
 N Number;
 P Varchar2(20) := '00000000000000000000'; -- 10 2-char pointers
 V Varchar2(40); -- The Order by string: up to 9 4-char strings.
 Nv Varchar2(1);
Begin
 For I in reverse 1+A..Pk1.Column_Count+A Loop
 Get_Row(I,1);
 If Order_By is not null then
 Nv := Substr(Order_By,1,1);
 C := Nvl(Substr(Order_By,2,1),'A');
 If Nv between '1' and '9' and C in ('A','D') then
 -- N is 1-9 (the order_by digit). C is ColNum + A/D (4 chars).
 N := To_Number(Substr(Order_By,1,1));
 C := Ltrim(To_Char(I-A,'099'))||Nvl(Substr(Order_By,2,1),'A');
 -- L is pointer where C goes into V.
 L := To_Number(Substr(P,2*N-1,2));
 -- Stuff C into V, truncate V to 36 (9 * 4-char units)
 V := Substr(Substr(V,1,L)||C||Substr(V,L+1),1,36);
 -- Add 4 to each pointer greater than N in P --
 For J in N+1..10 Loop
 C := Ltrim(To_Char(To_Number(Substr(P,2*J-1,2))+4,'00'));
 P:=Substr(P,1,2*J-2)||C||Substr(P,2*J+1);
 End Loop;
 End if;
 End if;
 End loop;
 L := Nvl(Length(V),0)/2+2;
 Change_Req := (Substr(P,1,L)<>Substr('00040812162024283236',1,L));
 If Change_Req then
 If Mode1=1 then
 N := Show_Alert('ORDER_BY');
 If N=Alert_Button1 then -- Cancel was pressed.
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure;
 End if;
 End if;
 For I in 1+A..Pk1.Column_Count+A Loop
 Set_Group_Char_Cell(IdOrd,I,Null);
 End loop;
 -- Put 'clean' values back into Rec Grp --
 For I in 1..Nvl(Length(V),0)/4 Loop
 Set_Group_Char_Cell(IdOrd,A+To_Number(Substr(V,4*I-3,3)),
 To_Char(I)||Replace(Substr(V,4*I,1),'A'));
 End loop;
 If Mode1=0 then
 Store_ATC_Setup(0); --Errs found from P01 call
 Else
 Mode1:=2; --Store setup btn: Need to re-display
 End if;
 End if;
 If Mode1=0 then
 Pk1.Order_By_String := V;
 End if;
End Check_Cleanup_Order_By;

 Procedure Get_Row_Details is begin
 ----------------------------------
 -- Gets column name, description, etc. for a row in TABLE RG
 -- Mode1 values determine which items and types of data to return.
 -- 0 = ColName, DataTyp, Required(null or Y), Display width.
 -- 1 = 0 + Length, Precisn, Scale, ColId, Seq (all columns from RG)
 -- 2 = 1 + ColDesc (for ATC display)

 DataTyp := Get_Group_Char_Cell(IdType,RowI);
 DsplyWid := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdDWid,RowI);

 --- Mode 1 ---
 ColId := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdColId, RowI);
 ColSeq := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdColSeq,RowI);
 DataLen:=null; Precisn:=null; Scale:=null;
 If DataTyp<>'DATE' then
 DataLen := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdLen,RowI);
 If DataTyp ='NUMBER' then
 Precisn := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdPrec,RowI);
 Scale := Get_Group_Number_Cell(IdScale,RowI);
 End if;
 End if;
 Order_By := Get_Group_Char_Cell(IdOrd,RowI);
 If Mode1=1 then Return; End if;

 --- Mode 2 & 3 ---
 -- Create ColDesc for ATC display and WNII hint message --
 ColDesc := DataTyp;
 If DataTyp ='NUMBER' then
 If Precisn is not null then
 ColDesc := ColDesc||Lp||to_char(Precisn)||','
 ||to_char(Scale)||')';
 -- build format text for WNII column hint --
 If Mode1=3 then
 ColDesc := ColDesc||' Format: '||To_Char(Power(10,-scale)
 *To_Number(Substr('9999999999999999999999',1,Precisn)));
 End if;
 End if;
 Elsif Instr(DataTyp,'CHAR')>0
 Or DataTyp='RAW' then
 ColDesc := ColDesc||Lp||To_Char(DataLen)||')';
 Elsif DataTyp='DATE' and Mode1=3 then
 -- build date value text for WNII column hint --
 Declare
 d Date;
 D_Txt Varchar2(30) := :System.Cursor_Value;
 D_Txt2 Varchar2(30);
 OK_Date Boolean;
 Begin
 If D_Txt is not null then
 U04_Check_Date(D_Txt,OK_Date,d,D_Txt2,'D3YT');
 If OK_Date then
 ColDesc := ColDesc||' Value: '||D_Txt2;
 End If;
 End If;
 End;
 End if;

 If Required = 'Y'
 and Mode1=3 then
 Required := ' (Required Field)';
 End if;
 End Get_Row_Details;

Begin -- Procedure Get_Row --------------------------------------------*

Procedure Get_Table1_Setup(RowN in integer,Mode1 in Varchar2) is
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
-- Gets the required table setup and stores it in the TABLE1 rec group.
-- Mode1: M: Get stored/default: called by P01_Setup
-- S: Get stored setup (called by WBP.B2.Retrieve_Setup_Btn)
-- D: Get default setup (called by WBP:B2.Default_Setup_Btn
-- RowN: Specifies which row to start adding to record group.
-- = 0 or col_count.
 ExtraWid Number := 0;
 LimitWid Number := 0;
 Macintosh Boolean
 :=(Get_Application_Property(Operating_System)='MACINTOSH');
 NewRowNum Integer;
 Stored_Count Integer := 0;
 Undef_Count Integer := 0;
 Wide_Col_Factor Number;

 Procedure Get_Data_Width is
 ---------------------------
 -- For a specific column, determines the width necessary to display
 -- the data on the form.
 TmpScale Number;
 Begin
 If DataTyp = 'NUMBER' then
 DsplyWid :=Nvl(Precisn,5);
 TmpScale:=Nvl(Scale,0);
 If TmpScale<1 then
 DsplyWid:=DsplyWid-TmpScale;
 Else
 DsplyWid:=1+greatest(DsplyWid,ABS(TmpScale));
 End if;
 Elsif DataTyp = 'DATE' then
 If Macintosh then
 DsplyWid:=9;
 else
 DsplyWid := 7;
 end if;
 Elsif DataTyp in ('VARCHAR2','CHAR') then
 --DsplyWid:= Least(25,DataLen)
 -- +Greatest(0,Round((DataLen-25)* Wide_Col_Factor)));
 DsplyWid := Least(25,DataLen);
 If DataLen>25 then
 ExtraWid := ExtraWid + DataLen - 25;
 End if;
 Elsif DataTyp = 'RAW' then
 DsplyWid := Least(15,2*DataLen);
 ELSE -- Long, etc.
 DsplyWid := 1;
 End if;
 LimitWid := LimitWid+DsplyWid;
 End Get_Data_Width;

Begin -- Get_Table1_Setup -- Main Procedure ----------------------------*
 If RowN=0 then
 Delete_Group_Row(RgId,All_Rows);
 End if;
 ColSeq := 0;
 NewRowNum := RowN;
 If Mode1<>'D' then -- S or M: try to get stored setup
 If Setup_Tbl_Exists is null then
 Begin -- Check if QA_SETUP table exists
 SELECT 'Y' into Setup_Tbl_Exists FROM USER_CATALOG

 and Table_Type ='TABLE';

 If Mode1='S' then
 Delete_Rows; --Clear second set of rows from rec grp.

 ------------------------
 --- Get stored setup: Use QA_Setup table to get recgrp values ---
 ------------------------
 Declare

 Begin
 If Id_null(ATCId) then
 -- Use rec group so this form will compile even if 
 -- table QA_Setup does not exist.
 ATCId:=Create_group_from_query('ATC',
 'SELECT Q.column_order,A.column_id,Q.Display_Width,'
 || 'Q.Order_By,A.column_name,A.data_type,A.data_length,'
 || 'A.data_precision,A.data_scale,A.nullable '
 ||'from all_tab_columns A, '||Pk1.QA_SETUP||' Q '
 ||'where A.owner=:b2.owner_actual '
 || 'and A.table_name=:b2.tbl_actual '
 || 'and Q.owner(+)=:b1.owner '
 || 'and Q.table_name(+)=A.table_name '

 ||'order by 1');
 ATC_ColOrd := find_column('ATC.COLUMN_ORDER');
 ATC_ColId := find_column('ATC.COLUMN_ID');
 ATC_DsplyWid := find_column('ATC.DISPLAY_WIDTH');
 ATC_Order_By := find_column('ATC.ORDER_BY');
 ATC_ColName := find_column('ATC.COLUMN_NAME');
 ATC_DataTyp := find_column('ATC.DATA_TYPE');
 ATC_DataLen := find_column('ATC.DATA_LENGTH');
 ATC_Precisn := find_column('ATC.DATA_PRECISION');
 ATC_Scale := find_column('ATC.DATA_SCALE');
 ATC_Nullable := find_column('ATC.NULLABLE');
 End if;
 PG_num := Populate_group(ATCId);
 If PG_num <> 0 then
 U05_Alert_msg('Pop.Grp(ATC) '||:b2.owner_actual||'.'
 ||:b2.tbl_actual||': ', dbms_error_text);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 For i in 1..get_group_row_count(ATCId) Loop
 ColOrd := get_group_number_cell(ATC_ColOrd ,i);
 ColId := get_group_number_cell(ATC_ColId ,i);
 DsplyWid := get_group_number_cell(ATC_DsplyWid,i);
 Order_By := get_group_char_cell (ATC_Order_By,i);
 ColName := get_group_char_cell (ATC_ColName ,i);
 DataTyp := get_group_char_cell (ATC_DataTyp ,i);
 DataLen := get_group_number_cell(ATC_DataLen ,i);
 Precisn := get_group_number_cell(ATC_Precisn ,i);
 Scale := get_group_number_cell(ATC_Scale ,i);
 Nullable := get_group_char_cell (ATC_Nullable,i);
 ColSeq := ColSeq + 1;
 If DataTyp = 'UNDEFINED' then
 Undef_count := Undef_count + 1;
 End if;
 -- edit/repair bogus values --
 If Nvl(DsplyWid,-1) not between 0 and 100 then
 Get_Data_Width;
 End if;
 If Order_By is not null
 and (Substr(Order_By,1,1) not between '1' and '9'
 or Length(Order_BY)=2 and Substr(Order_by,-1)<>'D') then
 Order_By := null;
 End if;
 NewRowNum := NewRowNum + 1;
 Add_Row(NewRowNum);
 End loop;
 If Mode1='S' then
 Message(' RETRIEVED '||to_char(newrownum-RowN)
 ||' ROWS FROM STORED SETUP',No_Acknowledge);
 End if;
 End;
 End if;
 End if;
 If Stored_Count=0 then
 -------------------------
 --- Get Default Setup ---
 -------------------------
 ExtraWid := 0;
 LimitWid := 0;
 Undef_count := 0;
 Begin
 For R in
 (SELECT column_id, -1 as DWidth,
 decode(column_id,1,'1',2,'2',3,'3',null)as OrdBy,column_name,
 data_type,data_length,data_precision,data_scale,nullable
 from all_tab_columns
 where owner = :b2.owner_actual
 and table_name = :b2.tbl_actual
 order by column_id )
 Loop
 ColId := R.column_id; DsplyWid := R.DWidth;
 Order_By := R.OrdBy; ColName := R.Column_name;
 DataTyp := R.data_type; DataLen := R.data_length;
 Precisn := R.data_precision; Scale := R.data_scale;
 Nullable := R.nullable;
 If DataTyp = 'UNDEFINED' then
 Undef_count := Undef_count + 1;
 End if;
 Get_Data_Width;
 ColSeq := ColSeq + 1;
 NewRowNum := NewRowNum + 1;
 Add_Row(NewRowNum);
 End loop;
 End;
 -- If there were any text columns wider than 25 characters, and the
 -- total widths of all columns is less than 100, then widen the text
 -- columns.
 If LimitWid >= 100 or ExtraWid=0 then
 Wide_Col_Factor := 0;
 Else
 Wide_Col_Factor := Round(.8 * greatest(100-LimitWid,0)
 / (greatest(LimitWid+ExtraWid,100)-LimitWid),4);
 End if;
 If Wide_Col_Factor>0 then
 For R2 in RowN+1..NewRowNum Loop
 Get_Row(R2,1);
 If DsplyWid = 25 and DataLen>25
 and DataTyp in ('VARCHAR2','CHAR') then
 DsplyWid := 25 + Round(Wide_Col_Factor * (DataLen-25) );
 Set_Group_Number_Cell(IdDWid,R2,DsplyWid);
 end if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End if;
 If Undef_count > 0 then
 U05_Alert_msg('Found '||Undef_count||' columns with data type'
 ||' = "UNDEFINED". Setup terminated.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
End Get_Table1_Setup;

Procedure Resequence_Columns is
----------------------------
-- Called by WBP on Reseq_Cols_Btn -- Resequences ATC display
-- based on the Col_Seq values entered in the ATC rows.
-- Sort and resequence the second set of rows in the TABLE1 rec group
 CursRec pls_integer;
 TopRec pls_integer;
 ColSeq1 Number;
--g2 = Group2 (second set of rows in TABLE1 rec grp)
-- Used as offset in all row manipulations.
 g2_first pls_integer := Column_Count+1;
 g2_last pls_integer := 2*Column_Count;
Begin ---- Resequence_Columns ----
 CursRec := :System.cursor_record;
 TopRec := Get_Block_Property('ATC',Top_record);
 For i in g2_first..g2_last Loop
 ColSeq1 := Get_group_number_cell(IdColSeq,i);
 If ColSeq1 = 1+i-g2_first then --seq. unchanged by user
 ColSeq1 := ColSeq1 + .1; --existing row follows new ones
 Set_group_number_cell(IdColSeq,i,ColSeq1);
 End if;
 If i > g2_first --compare ColSeq to prev row's value
 And ColSeq1 < Get_group_number_cell(IdColSeq,i-1) then
 Get_Row(i,1); -- get TABLE1 values for row
 Delete_Group_Row(RgId,i);--remove row, insert into new slot
 -- find slot where Col_Seq should be inserted
 For j in reverse g2_first..i-1 loop
 If Get_group_number_cell(IdColSeq,j) <= ColSeq then
 Add_Row(j+1); --insert after j row
 exit;
 Elsif j = g2_first then
 Add_Row(g2_first); --becomes first row in group
 exit;
 End if;
 End loop;
 End if;
 End loop;
 --Display resequenced result in ATC Block
 Clear_Block;
 Pk1.Do_ATC_Edits := False;
 For i in g2_first..g2_last Loop
 If i > g2_first then
 Next_Record;
 End If;
 Set_Group_Number_Cell(IdColSeq,i,i-column_count);--Renum ColSeq
 Pk1.Get_Row(i,2);
 Display_ATC_Row;
 End Loop;
 U72_Go_Rec_Sync_Block('ATC',CursRec,TopRec);
 Pk1.Do_ATC_Edits := True;
 Set_item_property('B2.RESEQ_COLS_BTN',Displayed,Property_False);
 Pk1.Reseq_Required := null;
End Resequence_Columns;

 function get_1_255_colors(txt_i varchar2) return varchar2 is
 -------------------------
 -- converts Forms builder colors to runtime colors:
 -- example: r50g100b75 --> r127g255b191
 -- all three values must be betweem 0 and 100.
 -- if not, then txt_i is returned unchanged.
 rtrn varchar2(12);
 c pls_integer := 0;
 p pls_integer;
 function conv(v in varchar2) return varchar2 is
 v2 varchar2(3);
 begin
 if num(v) between 0 and 100 then
 c := c+1;
 if v in('0','25','50','75','88','100') then
 if v='0' then v2:='0'; elsif v='25' then v2:='63';
 elsif v='50' then v2:='127'; elsif v='75' then v2:='191';
 elsif v='88' then v2:='223'; else v2:='255'; end if;
 else
 v2 := trunc(num(v)*2.55);
 end if;
 end if;
 return v2;
 end conv;
 begin
 begin
 p := instr(txt_i,'r')+1;
 rtrn := 'r'||conv(substr(txt_i,p,instr(txt_i,'g')-p));
 p := instr(txt_i,'g')+1;
 rtrn := rtrn||'g'||conv(substr(txt_i,p,instr(txt_i,'b')-p));
 rtrn := rtrn||'b'||conv(substr(txt_i,instr(txt_i,'b')+1 ));
 exception when others then c:=0;
 end;
 if c <> 3 then -- all values were not 1 to 100; ex: some > 100
 rtrn := txt_i; end if;
 return rtrn;
 end get_1_255_colors;

 if num(v) between 0 and 255 then

 if v in('0','63','127','191','223','255') then

 begin
 begin
 p := instr(txt_i,'r')+1;

PROCEDURE Z (M varchar2) IS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
--This procedure copied from ZDEBUG debugging form's AA procedure,
-- but with 4 changes: 4 lines with AA(... replaced with Z(...
--To use in QA:
--Ctrl+shift+click on Call Code. Then, clicking the Owner field works
--same as using Debug button from ZDebug form.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
--PROCEDURE z(M varchar2) IS
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------*
Setup: To set up a form you want to test, follow these steps:
(See "Using This Procedure" below for help calling this process.)

 1. Copy this procedure into your form.

 2. Do one of either 2a or 2b:
 2a. Copy the DEBUG button from block B1 to your form, and
 make sure its two triggers (when-mouse-click and
 when-button-pressed) are also included.

 2b. ... or: Create a When-Mouse-Click trigger on any item in the
 form (remember which item you use), and place the following
 two lines of code in the trigger:

-- When-Mouse-Click trigger to operate the z debugging procedure.
z('CONTROL'); --? Don't forget to delete this when testing is done.

------------------------------------------
Cleanup:
After testing is completed in a form, Delete this procedure
and the button or When-Mouse-Click trigger created above.
The '--?' string is what I use to search for things to remove
when testing is completed.
------------------------------------------
Note:
Do NOT use a pushbutton with a WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED trigger to activate
debugging, because the shift keys (Ctrl, Alt and Shift) are not
correctly recognized by Forms in the when-button-pressed trigger. You
should only use when-mouse-click. (A workaround, if the WBP trigger
MUST be used: Also create a when-mouse-down trigger with a single
null; command. This causes Forms to properly set shift key data.)
------------------------------------------

Using This Procedure
--------------------
 Procedure z stores and displays debugging messages. To see a 
 message from anywhere in your form, simply code a command such as:
 z('Any message here');
 If debugging has been activated (by clicking the Debug button),
 the message is stored for display when requested.
 
 The input M parameter is used to pass debugging messages and also
 to control the debug process. If the text in M is anything other
 than the control values below, it is considered a message to be
 stored and displayed.

 If the first character of the message is > or ", the message is sent
 to dbms_output rather than stored immediately in the record group.
 It then shows up within the DBMS_Output message stream when you
 display the debugging messages. This is useful when database
 triggers or packages issue dbms_output messages, so you can see all
 messages, both from your form as well as the server-side messages
 in sequence. (Alternately to using the > or " redirection character,
 if a stored procedure/package issues dbms_output messages, you can
 issue this command immediately after calling the procedure:
 z('DBMS_OUTPUT.QDISPLAY'); This will copy all dbms_output messages
 into the debugging messages queue.)

 Control commands: If the M parameter is set to any of the values
 below, they are used as controls to direct this process. Normally,
 you do not need to code any message calls to use these commands,
 since they are already set up in the 'Click_control' procedure
 below, which is used by a call from the B1.DEBUG button.
 If M is any of the following values, this process performs the
 described action:
 'TOGGLE' to turn on/off message storage
 'TOGGLEI' turn on message storage AND display messages to screen
 immediately as they are generated.
 'TOGGLE0' (TOGGLE and Zero) Turn off message storage
 'TOGGLE1' Turn on message storage
 'SHOW_MSGS' to display messages via zdebug form
 'CLEAR' to delete all stored messages
 'DBMS_OUTPUT.ENABLE Starts dbms_output recording. This is auto-
 matically turned on when message storage is started.
 'DBMS_OUTPUT.DISPLAY' Copies dbms_output msgs to rec. grp.
 Use DBMS_OUTPUT.QDISPLAY immediately after calling a
 stored procedure to display messages produced by that
 procedure.
 'DBMS_OUTPUT.DISABLE' Stops dbms_output recording AND clears any
 messages stored in the dbms_output buffer.
 'CONTROL' is issued from the When-Mouse-Click trigger. Controls
 actions within this process. Actions are described in the
 notes in the WMC trigger on the debug button.
 anything else: writes into rec group 'ZDEBUG' or to DBMS_Output;
*/

 RG RecordGroup := find_group('ZDEBUG');
 DBMS_OutB Boolean := False;
 Toggle_msg varchar2(100);
 Msg_flag varchar2(10);
 Btn_label varchar2(20);
 ----
 Procedure msg(M1 varchar2) is begin
 -- Msgs starting with > or " are dbms_Output msgs.
 If substr(M1,1,1) in ('"','>')
 and not DBMS_OutB then -- copying dbms_output to rec grp
 DBMS_Output.Put_line(substr(M1,2));
 Else
 Add_Group_Row(RG,END_OF_GROUP);
 set_group_char_cell('ZDEBUG.TXT', get_group_row_count(RG), M1);
 End if; -- I = Immediate msg
 if substr(Msg_flag,1,1) = 'I'
 and not DBMS_OutB then --Don't echo dbms_output to screen
 -- Also write message to screen in a pop-up window --
 if Msg_flag = 'I' then
 Message(M1);
 message(' ',no_acknowledge);
 elsif Msg_flag = 'I1' then
 Message(M1);
 else --'I1NA'
 Message(M1,no_acknowledge);
 end if;
 end if;
 End msg;
 ----
 Procedure Click_Control is
 -- Mouse_button_modifiers is a text string which is null or is a
 -- combination of: control+ shift+ and alt+
 mbm varchar2(30) := Name_in('SYSTEM.MOUSE_BUTTON_MODIFIERS');
 key_shift_state pls_integer -- counts '+' characters
 := Nvl(length(mbm) - length(translate(mbm,'A+','A')),0);
 Begin
 If key_shift_state = 0 then
 Clear_Message;
 Message
 (' Ctrl+Click=Debug on/off; Ctrl+Shft+Click=Show msgs;'
 ||' Ctrl+Alt+Shft+Click=Clear msgs,'
 ||' Alt+Click=msgs to screen. Msg_Flag='||Msg_flag
 ||' Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG')
 ,no_acknowledge);
 Elsif key_shift_state = 1 then
 if mbm = 'Alt+' then
 Z('TOGGLEI');
 else
 Z('TOGGLE');
 end if;
 Elsif key_shift_state = 2 then
 Z('SHOW_MSGS');
 Else -- key_shift_state = 3
 Z('CLEAR');
 End if;
 End Click_Control;
 ----
 Procedure msg2(M2 varchar2) is begin
 Clear_Message; --so message already on status line will not pop up.
 Message(M2,no_acknowledge);
 End msg2;
 ----
 Procedure DBMS_Out(M2 varchar2) is -- process DBMS_Output commands
 -- Cmds are ENABLE, DISABLE, DISPLAY. First char can be Q,
 -- Q=Quiet mode: Enabled/Disabled messages are suppressed
 quiet boolean := False;
 procedure QMsg(M varchar2) is begin
 if not quiet then Msg(M); end if;
 end QMsg;
 Begin
 --if nvl(Msg_flag,' ') = 'N' then
 -- return; -- do nothing
 --end if;
 If substr(M2,1,1)='Q' then
 quiet := True;
 End if;
 If M2 in('ENABLE','QENABLE') then
 dbms_output.enable(128000); --Starts dbms_output processing
 QMsg('---- DBMS_Output enabled ----');
 elsif M2 in('DISABLE','QDISABLE') then
 dbms_output.disable; --Stop dbms_output processing
 QMsg('---- DBMS_Output disabled. Buffer also cleared. ----');
 elsif M2 in('DISPLAY','QDISPLAY') then
 Declare
 cntr Pls_Integer := 0;
 Sts Integer;
 txt varchar2(300);
 Begin
 DBMS_OutB := True;
 Loop
 dbms_output.get_line(txt,sts);
 if sts=0 then
 if cntr = 0 then
 Msg('---- The following lines are from DBMS_Output ----');
 end if;
 cntr:= cntr+1;
 Msg(txt);
 else
 if cntr=0 then
 QMsg('---- End of DBMS_Output, no lines available.');
 else
 Msg('---- End of DBMS_Output, displayed '
 ||cntr||' lines. Buffer also cleared.');
 end if;
 exit;
 end if;
 End loop;
 DBMS_OutB := False;
 End;
 end if ;
 End DBMS_Out;
BEGIN
 -- Initialization: create global variable and record group
 Default_value('N','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 -- Name_in and Copy used so this process can run from a PLL library.
 Msg_Flag := Name_in('GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 if id_null(RG) then
 RG := Create_group_from_query('ZDEBUG',
 'Select rpad(chr(32),4000) TXT from dual',
 Global_Scope);
 end if;
 ----
 if upper(M) = 'CONTROL' then
 --- Debug button clicked --
 Click_Control;
 elsif upper(M) = 'SHOW_MSGS' then 
 --- Show Messages ---
 DBMS_Out('QDISPLAY');
 If get_group_row_count(RG) = 0
 and id_null(find_timer('ZDEBUG')) then
 Msg2(' No messages to display. '
 ||'Click again (within 5 seconds) to call zDebug form.');
 if id_null(Create_timer('ZDEBUG',5000,no_repeat)) then
 null;
 end if;
 else
 Clear_Message;
 Call_Form('ZDEBUG',No_hide);
 end if;
 ---
 elsif substr(upper(M),1,6) = 'TOGGLE' then
 --- Toggle Messages ---
 If upper(M)='TOGGLEI' then
 Copy('I','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 DBMS_Out('QENABLE');
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag OFF';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to I -- Messages output to screen';
 elsif upper(M)='TOGGLE1'
 or upper(M)='TOGGLE'
 and nvl(Msg_flag,' ') in('N',' ') then
 Copy('Y','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 DBMS_Out('QENABLE');
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag OFF';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to Y -- Messages can now '
 ||'be created. Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG');
 else -- all other conditions:
 -- M='TOGGLE0' or M='TOGGLE' and Global in('Y','I')
 Copy('N','GLOBAL.ZDEBUG_MSG_FLAG');
 DBMS_Out('QDISABLE');--stops msg recording AND clears msg buffer
 Btn_label := 'Set Msg flag ON';
 Toggle_msg := 'Msg_Flag set to N -- Messages will no longer '
 ||'be created. Msgs='|| get_group_row_count('ZDEBUG');
 end if;
 Msg2(' ' || Toggle_msg);
 -- If running inside zDebug form, change button label:
 If not id_null(find_item('B1.DEBUG_MSG_ON_OFF')) then
 set_item_property('B1.DEBUG_MSG_ON_OFF',Label,Btn_Label);
 End if;
 ---
 elsif upper(M) = 'CLEAR' then
 --- Clear Messages ---
 DBMS_Out('QDISABLE');--stops msg recording AND clears msg buffer
 if substr(Msg_flag,1,1) in('Y','I') then
 DBMS_Out('QENABLE');
 end if;
 Msg2(' All ( '||get_group_row_count(RG)
 ||' ) stored messages cleared. Msg_Flag='
 ||Msg_flag);
 delete_group_row(RG,all_rows);
 ---
 elsif upper(substr(M,1,12)) = 'DBMS_OUTPUT.' then
 DBMS_Out(upper(substr(M,13)));
 elsif nvl(Msg_flag,' ') <> 'N' then
 Msg(M); -- store/display msg
 end if;
END;

-- Synchronizes the display of any scrollable block.
-- After running an edit that loops through all records, this will
-- restore the block's display so that the same top record is again
-- at the top of the block's display.
-- Blk is the name of the block.
-- Rec_Num is the desired target current record.
-- Top_Rec is the original Top Record of the block captured
-- before the looping process began.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------*
 ( Blk Varchar2,
 Rec_Num number,
 Top_Rec number )
is
 Blk_ID Block;
 Top_New PLS_Integer;
 Rec_n PLS_Integer;
Begin
 Blk_Id := Find_Block(Blk);
 If Id_Null(Blk_Id) then
 U01_MSGE('U72_Go_Rec_Synch_Block: Cannot find block '''
 ||Blk||'''','F');
 End if;
 If Blk <> :System.Cursor_Block then
 Go_Block(Blk);
 If not form_success then
 Raise Form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 End if;
 If :System.Cursor_Record <> Rec_Num then
 GO_RECORD(Rec_Num);
 End if;
 -- may need to re-set the display to the rows originally shown
 Top_New := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(Blk_Id,Top_Record);
 If Top_Rec <> Top_New then
 If Top_Rec < Top_New then
 If :System.cursor_record <> Top_rec then
 Go_Record(Top_Rec);
 End if;
 Else
 Rec_n := get_block_property(Blk_Id,Records_Displayed)
 + Top_Rec - 1;
 If :System.cursor_record <> Rec_n then
 Go_Record(Rec_n);
 End if;
 End if;
 Synchronize;
 If :System.Cursor_Record <> Rec_Num then
 GO_RECORD(Rec_Num);
 End if;
 End if;
 -- can't go_rec to NEW record, so need to test here
 If :System.last_record = 'TRUE'
 and Rec_Num = 1 + :System.Cursor_Record then
 Next_Record;
 End if;
End U72_Go_Rec_Sync_Block;

-- On-Message trigger --*
DECLARE 
 errtype VARCHAR2(3) := MESSAGE_TYPE;
 errcod NUMBER := MESSAGE_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := MESSAGE_TEXT;
BEGIN
 If ErrCod in (40301, -- Qry caused no recs 2B retrieved, Re-enter
 40350, -- Qry caused no recs 2B retrieved
 40352, --Last rec. of qry retrieved
 40353, --Qry cancelled
 40355) --Qry will retrieve n records
 -- Block WNII hint message following any of the above messages
 then Pk1.WNII_MESSAGE_BLOCK := 'Y';
 End If;
 IF errcod = 40301 THEN-- query caused no recs...re-enter
 U08_Cancel_Query('START');
 Elsif errcod=40353 -- Query cancelled
 and Pk1.U08_Cancel_Query='Y' then
 Pk1.U08_Cancel_Query := null;
 Elsif errcod=40653 then --Rec not resrvd for upd/del--try later
 If Get_Block_Property('D',Update_Allowed)='FALSE' then
 Message(' CANNOT LOCK ROWS ON A DISPLAY-ONLY TABLE OR VIEW');
 Else
 Message(' CANNOT LOCK THIS ROW');
 End if;
 Else
 Message(' '||errtype||'-'||to_char(errcod)||': '||errtxt);
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF; 
END;

-- On-Error trigger --*
DECLARE 
 errcod NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 Erritm Boolean := False;
 Msg Varchar2(1000)
 :=' '||Error_type||'-'||to_char(errcod)||': '||Error_text;
 dbms_txt Varchar2(3000);
BEGIN
 If ErrCod = 40200 -- Field is protected against update
 or errcod = 40102 then -- Record must be entered or deleted first
 If :System.trigger_block='D' then
 Erritm := True;
 -- Newly inserted record without rowid cannot be updated.
 If Pk1.Display_Only = 'F'
 and :D.RowID is null
 and :System.record_status = 'QUERY' then
 Msg:=' YOU MUST REQUERY BEFORE UPDATING A NEW RECORD IN THIS TABLE';
 End if;
 End If;
 End if;
 If Erritm then
 U01_Msge(Msg);
 Elsif errcod between 40100 and 40399 --various frm-based errs
 or errcod in (
 40102, --Rec must be entered or deleted first.
 41008 --undefined fn key(dbms_txt=ora-01003:no stmt parsed)
 ) then
 Message(Msg);
 Elsif errcod = 41072 --FRM-41072: Cannot create Group <name>
 -- (if run in non-English environment, phrase is different)
 and ( instr(Msg,'FR')> 0 --Occurs in D.On-select trigger
 or instr(Msg,'MRU')>0)then --From P08 create group
 Pk1.DBMS_Err_txt := substr(DBMS_ERROR_TEXT,1,100);
 Else -- check/display database error message
 dbms_txt := SUBSTR(DBMS_ERROR_TEXT,1,3000);
 If dbms_txt is null
 or substr(dbms_txt,5,5) = '01403' then --1403=no data found
 Message(Msg);
 else
-- the following commented lines missed 41072; there may be others.
-- so they are not used.
-- and ( errcod between 40501 and 40599
-- or errcod in(40735, 21011) )--FRM-40735: unhandled exception
-- -- FRM-21011: PL/SQL unhandled exception %s.
-- and instr(upper(Msg),'ORACLE ERROR') > 0 then
 -- show MSG and DBMS_TXT, insert CR in msg before each 'ORA-'
 U05_Alert_Msg(ltrim(Msg)||' ',
 replace(dbms_txt, 'ORA-', chr(13)||'ORA-') );
 --This sets DBMS_Error_Text to 01403, so dbms_txt won't be
 --repeated if two errors are encountered.
 begin select null into dbms_txt from dual where 1=2;
 exception when no_data_found then null; end;
 End if;
 End if;
 Raise Form_Trigger_Failure;
END;

 Procedure Set_MDI_Window_New is
 -------------------------------
 -- Starting form the first time, or from a different (not this) form.
 -- Enlarge MDI window if necessary --
 -- Forces width to at least the minimum; Height doesn't change.
 -- Maximizes window if monitor is using 640x480 coordinates
 W Number := Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Width);
 H Number := Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Height);
 Begin
 If Get_Application_Property(User_Interface) = 'WEB' then
 MinW := MinW + .146; -- =14/96 96 pixels per inch
 MinH := MinH + 1.29; -- 124/96
 end if;
 If W < MinW then -- set width wider to at least MinW
 Set_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_State,Maximize);
 If 1+MinW > Get_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Width) then
 :Parameter.MDI_Window_Parms := '-';
 Else
 Set_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_State,Normal);
 If FirstItm <> 'B1.TABLE' then
 H := Greatest(H,MinH);
 End if;
 Set_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_Size,MinW,H);
 End if;
 End if;
 End Set_MDI_Window_New;

 Procedure Set_MDI_Window_2nd_Copy is
 ------------------------------------
 -- Form is being started from another run of this form, so it will
 -- start with same window dimensions (with minimum width limit), and
 -- will (possibly) cascade the window.
 x varchar2(10); y varchar2(10); w varchar2(10); h varchar2(10);
 i integer := 0; j integer := 0;
 Function Num return Varchar2 is begin
 i := j+1;
 j := Instr(:Parameter.MDI_Window_Parms,',',i);
 Return To_Char(Greatest(0,
 To_Number(Substr(:Parameter.MDI_Window_Parms,i,j-i))));
 End Num;
 Begin
 x:=num; y:=num; w:=num; h:=num;
 w:=greatest(w,MinW);
 Set_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Position,x,y);
 Set_Window_Property(Forms_MDI_Window,Window_Size,w,h);
 End Set_MDI_Window_2nd_Copy;

DECLARE -- --*

BEGIN

 Go_Item('B1.CALL_CODE');

 U08_CANCEL_QUERY;

 U10_CLEAR_FORM;
 ELSIF TIMER_NAM='PK2_TIMER1' THEN
 PK2.TIMER1;
 ELSIF TIMER_NAM='NOLOCK' THEN--Flag started by pre-commit
 Null; -- used by D.On-Lock
 ELSIF TIMER_NAM='ZDEBUG' then null; --Started/used for debugging
